notes: Community tutorial site (mojodojo.dev): intro-to-mojo, builtins, decorators, std guides (String, Vector, Pointer, Buffer, Random, Sort, Time, Benchmark, Assert), examples and benchmarks, plus 3 blog posts and the definitions page. All .md files only; the matching .ipynb notebooks were excluded as duplicates of the .md content. CAVEAT - STALE: last commit 2023-08-23, i.e. Mojo 0.x era, three years before Mojo 1.0 (Aug 2026). Many APIs it teaches have since been renamed or removed (e.g. DynamicVector -> List, Buffer/NDBuffer -> Span/UnsafePointer, DTypePointer -> UnsafePointer), so this file teaches outdated Mojo and should be weighted accordingly next to the current official Manual (mojo_manual.txt). Included anyway because it is the most comprehensive community tutorial with a verified free licence.
